explainer_selection.why_not_tree_explainer: TreeExplainer requires ensemble decision tree structures (Random Forest, LightGBM, XGBoost). It is mathematically incompatible with kernel Support Vector Machines.
explainer_selection.why_not_linear_explainer: LinearExplainer assumes linear decision boundaries f(x) = w^T x + b. Our champion model uses a non-linear Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel, which projects data into an infinite-dimensional feature space; hence LinearExplainer is inapplicable.
explainer_selection.kernel_explainer_suitability: KernelExplainer is a model-agnostic explainer rooted in cooperative game theory. It uses weighted local linear surrogate models (LIME-style) to estimate exact Shapley values on probability outputs. By wrapping the entire Pipeline (StandardScaler + SVC), explanations are computed directly in the original, unscaled 30 cytological measurement space with full pipeline fidelity.
